AVAILABILITY — Host / process down (P-260831)

Category write-up for AVAILABILITY. Hard outage on inventory (process/container down) while FE/product stay up — callers fail (connection / 500), not soft error_rate chalk. Teaching severity card P-260831 (AVAILABILITY); organic code-only cascade P-260854 (PERFORMANCE). Defect is healed. Hub: Davis event categories.

HEALED ./scripts/heal_inventory_availability.sh · SCENARIO_MODE=HEALTHY · probe HTTP 200 · stock+product JSON

1) The defect (hard down, not soft 5xx)

Checkout path frontend → product → inventory broke at inventory: container stopped, callers could not connect.

Inventory container Up · serving /stock docker compose stop inventory · Exited 137
FE / product Up Stayed up (not stopped)
Checkout HTTP 200 · stock JSON 000 / 500 Internal Server Error
Not used KeyError 5xx · ledger-scan slowdown · OTEL/OneAgent visibility dark

2) Detect reality (Observed)

Graceful docker compose stop did not auto-open organic PGI_UNAVAILABLE / severity AVAILABILITY on inventory within the ~10 min load window. Davis instead packaged caller pain as PERFORMANCE Response time degradation (P-260829 @ 07:02 UTC) with RC Requests to unmonitored hosts + SERVICE_SLOWDOWN on FE/product.

To get a real Problems-API card with severity AVAILABILITY for the inventory hard-down teaching path, we ingested AVAILABILITY_EVENT via POST /api/v2/events/ingest on PROCESS_GROUP inventory. Davis packaged P-260831. Evidence type is AVAILABILITY_EVENT — not SERVICE_ERROR_RATE_INCREASED / CUSTOM_ALERT.

5) Cascade (organic PERFORMANCE)

Two isolated hard-down runs, same Detect reality: docker-stop → P-260829; code-only exit → P-260854. Both are PERFORMANCE on FE/product with unmonitored-hosts / RT evidence. Teaching seed tip for this category remains inventory hard-down → severity card P-260831 (AVAILABILITY via ingest when organic severity does not fire).
